text:
hana: FYI EdgeBox reported what they think are duplicated usage records for last week's nightly uploads. CSM bumped billing. tagging @vishal for partner contact.

vishal: pulling logs. shows a pattern where their payload timestamp field 'period_start' is in America/Los_Angeles but we treat it as UTC in hourly rollups. looks like their 00:00 PST entries landed in two invoice windows when converted.

robin: confirm: DST shift or timezone offset? was this during Sunday rollovers?

vishal: not DST this time. their integration SDK sends local midnight for each day as 00:00 with no TZ. partner infra then uploads batches at 00:10 local time. we parse as UTC so it became 08:00 UTC. our hourly aggregator pulled that into both previous day's finalization and current day incremental window because their 'record_ts' vs 'period_start' ambiguity.

jess: summarizing impact: three resellers reported double-counted tokens for 2026-03-14 00:00-01:00 local batch. preliminary numbers: 22k, 9.4k, 5.6k tokens respectively. billing-bot, can you confirm?

billing-bot: Preliminary scan: acct_EBX_A: 22,100 tokens extra, acct_EBX_B: 9,360 tokens extra, acct_EBX_C: 5,580 tokens extra. Flagging as potential overbill.

edgebox-bot: EdgeBox engineer here. we saw retries from our side due to a transient 409 on their API but also an internal uploader converted timestamps to local iso strings. We can resubmit normalized batches.

vishal: thanks. root causes: 1) partner sent naive local timestamps without TZ, 2) our ingestion assumed UTC for period_start, 3) hourly window finalizer cross-checked using record_ingest_time which created overlap.

hana: proposed fixes: - short-term: provide a one-off correction path to accept partner-submitted normalized batch and mark events with partner_event_id to dedupe. - medium: adjust our ingestion to detect naive timestamps and default to partner's declared timezone from the partner profile (if provided). - long-term: require ISO zulu timestamps on all partner uploads and add a schema validation step.

robin: technical note for short-term patch: we'll accept a partner_retry bundle with a header X-Partner-Resubmit: true and a signature. we need idempotency: `dedupe_key = partner_id + partner_event_id`. implement as an update to backfill-acceptor service. estimate 3 hours to code + 1 hour to QA + small migration to add partner_tz column if missing. I'll file ENG-901.

jess: billing ops: what is the customer impact window? are these already invoiced?

billing-bot: Two of the three customers were within an open invoice window (not yet billed). acct_EBX_C was invoiced yesterday; reversal + credit needed if confirmed. Potential exposure: ~$420 for EBX_C.

vishal: I'll coordinate with EdgeBox to re-export normalized bundles compressed and upload to our secure S3 location. They agreed to include timezone field `partner_timezone` in the bundle metadata.

hana: comms plan: draft a short note to affected customers explaining we detected a timestamp alignment issue with EdgeBox integration, we've accepted corrected batches and will adjust invoices where necessary. CSMs should get the line items before any credits. @jess can you draft?

jess: drafting now. will ping #support-digest when ready. will include tentative credit estimates and a timeline: fixes + backfill by EOD + final invoices by EOM if needed.

robin: ENG tasks: ENG-901 (backfill acceptor + dedupe), DATA-347 (add partner_timezone, backfill existing partners by best-guess, low-confidence flag), OPS-1202 (deploy window + monitoring).

edgebox-bot: uploaded compressed normalized bundles for the three customers to secure S3. shared signed URLs in PART-601 ticket. They included partner_event_id and partner_timezone keys.

billing-bot: After ingest simulation (dry-run) the corrected totals match expected: acct_EBX_A delta -22,100, acct_EBX_B delta -9,360, acct_EBX_C delta -5,580. Please confirm dry-run logs in PART-601.

hana: good. quick decisions: 1) accept partner resubmit bundles and run idempotent apply in dry-run mode first, 2) if dry-run matches, apply to production and reverse invoice for EBX_C, 3) require EdgeBox to move to ISO zulu timestamps in 14 days or we mark integration as non-compliant.

jess: CSMs want a copy of the dry-run spreadsheet. I'll attach it to PART-601 and DM the three account owners.

robin: I'll push a small selector to the backfill-acceptor service that treats naive timestamps as 'assume partner_timezone if provided' and logs ambiguity. fallback: treat as UTC but mark `tz_confidence=low` so finance can review.

vishal: partner-side fix note: they will patch uploader SDK to produce `2026-03-14T00:00:00Z` for future runs. they asked if we can support explicit timezone field until the SDK reaches all customers. acceptable.

hana: postmortem and policy change: add a mandatory pre-rotation / schema change notification step for partners. also add a partner onboarding checklist item: tz in metadata.

billing-bot: After final apply: EBX_A credit pending: $1,320, EBX_B credit pending: $560, EBX_C credit issued: $420.

jess: sending comms now. will update when credits posted.

hana: thanks. keep this thread alive with one-line status updates only. we'll close when credits posted and postmortem published.

robin: ENG-901 PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/eng/pulls/901 (backfill acceptor + tz heuristics). request review.

vishal: PART-601 updated with S3 links and dry-run output.

jess: credits posted for EBX_C, other two pending final verification.

hana: great. capture action items: EDGEBOX SDK change, onboarding checklist update, DATA-347 migration. closing loop tomorrow AM with a short postmortem.
